entities.name: Norman
entities.description: Originally an anti-hero who suffered betrayal by his companions, he was manipulated by Elizabeth Pristine until he embraced a villainous path, becoming the Paleborn.
entities.quote: from that moment a new villain awoke.norman the paleborn.and he shook hand with khalid again.

entities.name: Liam
entities.description: A hero and former friend of Norman who was away gaining magical knowledge and remained unaware of Norman's mistreatment by the organization.
entities.quote: we can see that liam ,even though he wasn't there back then with the org they were working.he was away for more knowledge with magic

entities.name: Silas
entities.description: A solo fighter wielding blue flames who has no interest in the organization and sought to address the threat he perceived in Elizabeth Pristine.
entities.quote: it was silas.he wasn't in that org.as we know he was a solo man,blue flame in his hand.

entities.name: the org
entities.description: The central organization of heroes that Norman, Liam, and others were associated with, though it became hostile toward Norman.
entities.quote: norman first starts as a anti hero.but when others couldn't take his changes.he slowly get punished or avoided by other companion he had.

timeline_events.title: The Betrayal and Awakening of the Paleborn
timeline_events.description: Following a series of manipulations by Elizabeth Pristine, Norman was framed for killing members of the organization, leading to the death of his humanity and his return to Khalid.
timeline_events.quote: seeing that liam directly attacked ,but all of a sudden the girl came infront of norman and got hit. now norman couldn't take this and seeing his only hope injured he got angry

timeline_events.title: The Death of Elizabeth Pristine
timeline_events.description: After Norman's death, Pristine fought the Sentinels in a hopeless battle, ultimately choosing to die with a final acknowledgment of her bond with Khalid.
timeline_events.quote: She falls, and in her last words she spits out both warning and prophecy: “You defeated the love I chose... but prepare for the agony that chose me.”
